Technology July 31, 2026 · 2:39 PM UTC

Is Apple heading for an iPhone shortage?

Apple shares dropped 7.3% before the bell on Friday as the tech giant warned that supply constraints would hurt growth, prompting investors to look beyond near-term shortages to gauge the hit from an expected iPhone price hike. Peter Devlin reports.
